purpose: Show correct current history in each watched conversation while unrelated activity continues.

necessity.when: Read the full watched history on initial load or recovery when the consumer lacks a usable snapshot and verified changes cannot reconstruct it.
necessity.otherwise: For unrelated conversation changes, do not fetch or rebuild watched history. On material watched-history changes, use the existing verified change path and fetch only what correctness requires.

preserve: Initial subscriber obtains complete history and recovery restores correct state.
An older saved edit and attachment replacement reach each watching consumer even if row count and latest row are unchanged.
Live updates retain message identity as they become saved history.

acceptance.positive: Through real save and subscriptions, older text and attachment changes reach each watcher and the initial load is complete.
acceptance.contrary: Unrelated saves trigger zero full reads or projections of unchanged watched history, including while another conversation streams.
